name: Mippei Yarimakuri Elevator ~Konamaiki na Musume ni Oshioki o
original_name: 密閉やりまくりエレベーター ～小生意気な娘に御仕置きを
source:
The protagonist, who lost his wife when he was still very young, lives with his only daughter, Saki.  Saki is cruel, and looks down on him with disgust.

One day, Saki visits the protagonist at work.  There's an accident, and the two of them wind up trapped together in the elevator.

Awaiting rescue alone with Saki in the tightly enclosed space, he begins to notice how closely she resembles his late wife.  Suddenly, the desires he had suppressed in his heart begin to stir...

translation:
主人公在很小的时候就失去了妻子，和他唯一的女儿咲生活在一起。咲希很残忍，厌恶地瞧不起他。

有一天，咲希去上班的地方拜访了主角。一场意外，两人被困在电梯里。

他和咲希独自在密闭的空间里等待救援，他开始注意到她与他已故的妻子有多么相似。突然，他内心压抑的欲望开始蠢蠢欲动……
